purpose: Per-query search volume + no-result rate + click attribution (Search->Click CTR)
selected_fields: content_id (as query), action_type, user_id, session_id, created_at, content_type, current_page_route
joins: self-join search_events to clicks_on_search on who=COALESCE(user_id::text
groupings: action_type IN (SEARCH,SEARCH_NORESULT,SEARCH_LOWRESULT) for search side; action_type IN (CLICK,VIDEO_CLICK,VIDEO_PLAY) AND current_page_route='/search' for click side; 7-day window; test-user exclusion
used_in_admin_ui: no (only query text + aggregated counts; query text could theoretically contain personal info typed by user - see privacy notes)
column18: YES - this is the primary Search->Click measurement query; does NOT extend to Generate
column19: Denominator ('searches') undercounts true search volume because healthy un-narrowed searches with >=5 results never fire a SEARCH event (per curify-frontend evidence) - inflates apparent no-result/CTR rates; 5-minute window is a heuristic not a hard link; documented redirect gap (search->topics redirects never fire a /search click event)
